final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT r.ordervault, u.acctscope, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM riskandmargin AS r JOIN orders AS o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault COLLATE BINARY JOIN users AS u ON o.userlink = u.userstamp COLLATE BINARY GROUP BY r.ordervault, u.acctscope), step2 AS (SELECT acctscope, SUM(record_count) AS total FROM step1 GROUP BY acctscope), step3 AS (SELECT SUM(total) AS grand_total FROM step2), step4 AS (SELECT s.acctscope, s.total, CAST(s.total AS REAL) / t.grand_total AS ratio FROM step2 AS s JOIN step3 AS t ON t.grand_total IS NOT NULL), step5 AS (SELECT AVG(total) AS average_total FROM step4) SELECT s.acctscope, s.total, s.ratio, CAST(s.total AS REAL) / a.average_total FROM step4 AS s JOIN step5 AS a ON a.average_total IS NOT NULL
